notes.title: Patch Notes for Snowbrawll 1.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We're excited to announce that the Deathmatch mode is now fully playable online, no need for Steam Remote Play anymore! You can now jump into fast-paced battles with your friends.

What’s next on the roadmap?

In the coming months, we’ll be bringing online support to the Football mode as well. On top of that, we’re working on new maps and fresh game modes to expand Snowbrawll into a rich and chaotic party game experience.

What kind of new modes?

Our next big goal is to create a high-speed racing mode, think a mix between SpeedRunners and Mario Kart, all with the Snowbrawll twist thay we love.

Thanks for playing, and stay tuned for more updates!
